node.title: L1 exact-shell balanced shifted-lattice reduction
node.statement: At agreement m>k with w=m-k, omega=n-m, and 2m<=n+k-1, form the shifted interpolation module M_U={(W,N):N=W Uhat mod Omega}. A reduced basis has degrees d1+d2=n-k+1. If d1<=w, the unguarded support census is empty or all m-subsets of one unique codeword's exact agreement set of size n-d1>=m+1, so the complete-agreement level-m shell is empty. Hence every nonempty exact shell has w+1<=d1<=d2<=omega and lies uniquely in the balanced pencil (W,N)=A g1+B g2 with coefficient-space dimension omega-w+1, W a monic degree-omega divisor of Omega, and exactness guard gcd(Q,W)=1. No balanced-pencil count or finite base-field budget is proved.
